title: The Threefold Prayer and the Threefold Sending
description: The whole arc of redemption traced back to the cry of Divine Truth fallen into mingling and the Father's threefold answer. The Mother of Life intercedes for the First Man in the depths; the Living Spirit (the first Expander) raises him and gives him a country of rest; the Five intercede; the Third Ambassador chooses out the Living Soul from harsh Hades; and Jesus the Radiance completes the purpose-of-heart of the elements, confirming the regenerate as freemen unto eternity.
